quote: Bernhard Riemann posed the Riemann Hypothesis in his 1859 paper 'Ueber die Anzahl der Primzahlen unter einer gegebenen Grösse' (On the Number of Primes Less Than a Given Magnitude)
note: This is the original statement of the Riemann Hypothesis itself, not the generalized version. The hypothesis appears as a remark in Riemann's 1859 memoir on the distribution of prime numbers.
